```sql
SELECT u."DisplayName", u."Location"
FROM main."users" u
JOIN main."posts" p ON u."Id" = p."OwnerUserId"
WHERE p."PostTypeId" = 2
  AND p."Id" IN (
    SELECT q."AcceptedAnswerId"
    FROM main."posts" q
    WHERE q."AcceptedAnswerId" IS NOT NULL
  )
  AND p."CreaionDate" >= '2013-06-01'
  AND p."CreaionDate" < '2013-07-01'
GROUP BY u."Id", u."DisplayName", u."Location"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
